profile.name: Rachel Monroe
profile.summary: Talent acquisition professional with 7 years in tech scale-ups. Passionate about candidate experience and inclusive hiring.

descriptions: Run full-cycle recruitment for 60+ engineering hires per year, cutting time-to-hire from 52 to 34 days
Source passive candidates daily via LinkedIn Recruiter; 35% response rate
Own the Greenhouse ATS configuration, scorecards and reporting
Train managers in structured, competency-based interviewing
Led employer branding refresh: careers site, Glassdoor presence and campus events
Designed a 30-60-90 day onboarding programme with a 95% new-hire satisfaction score
Built Workday dashboards for headcount and funnel analytics; HR analytics review monthly with the COO
Launched DEI sourcing initiative that raised female engineering shortlists from 18% to 31%
Advised on compensation and benefits bands and offer approvals
Supported clients on employment law basics for contractor engagement
Greenhouse, Workday, LinkedIn Recruiter, Power BI, Boolean search
